//: Set the project's Root Directory to `web` in Vercel; this file is read from there. Both commands step up to the repo root first: pnpm must install the whole workspace (web depends on @ca/demo and @ca/shared by `workspace:*`), and those packages are consumed as built `dist/` — they are serverExternalPackages, so Next never compiles them and `tsc -b` has to run before `next build`.
//env: DEMO_RUNNER_ENABLED is deliberately absent. The live runner spawns the Claude CLI, binds Bob on a fixed port and writes recordings to disk — none of which a serverless function can do — so /api/run answers 503 with reason:runner-disabled here and the dashboard falls back to the recorded run. Live runs stay on the demo laptop.
